newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon Expo 1998 is well over budget - paper.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon Expo 1998 is well over budget - paper.

text.p: Costs of preparations for the Lisbon 1998 World Fair have gone over the budget, according to the latest figures, Diario Economico newspaper reported.
It quoted a government source as saying that the latest estimates showed additional costs of 25 billion escudos.
Expo authorities had previously reported overspending of 30 billion escudos above the the initial budget of 215 billion.
Incorporating the latest figures, the total budget would now be at least 270 billion escudos.
Last week former EU Commissioner Antonio Cardoso e Cunha quit as the chief organiser of Expo, saying he could not maintain a climate of "political neutrality" in the project.
The government has appointed businessman Jose Torres Campos to replace him.
